thread:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — Snowflake reached out: they want to do a coordinated announcement with Qdrant + DGX partner on Apr 14. They want marketplace listing, joint blog + partner quote. Can we map owners for tech signoff, listing, and legal?

Ethan (Infra): I can own the compatibility smoke tests. Need sample dataset + representative query patterns from Snowflake and Qdrant. Any timeline?

Jules (Field): We have a pilot customer willing to be quoted if marketplace listing is live by Apr 10. That's hard deadline for their internal comms.

Sven (HW): DGX partner flagged a dependency on firmware >=5.3 for the GPU kernel path we use. There's a partner firmware rollout next Tue — I'll confirm whether partner fleet will have 5.3 by Apr 5.

Ava (Eng): I can do the connector manifest + adapter PR. Plan: add integration tests, and a compatibility matrix doc. ETA: initial PR by Apr 5 if I get sample queries. @Ethan can you post the test harness details?

Ethan (Infra): Test harness: small container that runs our adapter against sample Snowflake export and a Qdrant vector-store replica. Quick smoke command (dev only):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"adapter":"qdrant-snowbridge","action":"ingest","file":"sample_1000.csv"}' https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/connectors/run
```
Expected quick pass: ingest completes <120s, vectors created, 5 sample queries return results with cosine>=0.78. I'll spin up a job and paste logs.

marketplace-bot: Draft marketplace listing created: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/drafts/snow-qdrant-dgx-3067804321 (owner: Priya)

Dave (Legal): Please route the draft announcement + partner logos to me. Also need the data handling blurb for the marketplace listing (how customer data moves between Snowflake -> adapter -> Qdrant). Can't have any PII leakage language.

Priya (Partnerships): Action list (owners + due dates):
- Sample query patterns from Snowflake/Qdrant (owner: Snowflake PM) — due Apr 1
- Adapter PR + tests (owner: Ava) — due Apr 5
- Infra smoke run & logs (owner: Ethan) — due Apr 6
- DGX firmware confirmation (owner: Sven) — due Apr 3
- Marketplace draft review & legal blurb (owner: Dave) — due Apr 7
- Marketing blog draft + partner quotes (owner: Priya/Jules) — first cut Apr 8

Ava (Eng): Noted. I'll include a versioned manifest like: `adapter:v1.2`, `kernel:gpu-optimized-5.3`, and a compatibility row for Snowflake SQL dialect + Qdrant vector schema.

Ethan (Infra): Kicked off a staging run. Partial logs:
[ingest-job-8792] START -> exporting sample_1000.csv from snowbridge
[ingest-job-8792] TRANSFORM -> generating vectors (model: star-embed-3-small)
[ingest-job-8792] COMPLETE -> 1000 vectors created, avg latency 90ms/vector
Quick health: 100% connectivity to Qdrant replica, no schema errors. Posting full logs to the run: https://redwood.internal/runs/8792

Sven (HW): Confirmed with DGX partner PM: fleet will be at firmware 5.3 by Apr 4. We'll block a partner validation node for the week of Apr 6 for a soak test.

Jules (Field): I'll get the customer legal opt-in for the quote by Apr 2 and collect a short quote. Also looping in partner AE to verify co-marketing scope.

Dave (Legal): Received marketplace blurb draft — left inline comments about telemetry & retention. Priya, can you confirm we won't claim managed-data residency for partner-hosted replicas? Need explicit callout.

Priya (Partnerships): Good catch. We'll add a clarifying sentence: "Partner-managed vector replicas are subject to partner's residency and retention policies; Redwood's listing documents connection behavior only."

Ava (Eng): One technical question: for the adapter we plan to support two modes — CDN-pulled batch ingest and streaming via Snowflake external functions. Which does the partner prefer for launch? @Jules any customer preference?

Jules (Field): Pilot customer prefers streaming for freshness. Could we support streaming as a beta and batch for GA?

Ava (Eng): Yes, we can do streaming beta. I'll flag in the PR and add a `beta_streaming` feature toggle.

Priya (Partnerships): Final check: marketing wants a consolidated timeline to send to Snowflake and partners. I'll assemble the timeline from the action items and send a one-pager by EOD today. Please update owners if anything changes. :rocket:

Ethan (Infra): All green on infra side for now. Will post full smoke-run artifacts by tomorrow morning.

marketplace-bot: Reminder — marketplace listings with partner badges require partner legal approval before publish.

Priya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — let's reconvene Fri 10am PT for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
